en.topic_title: In Pictures: ‘Utterly exhausting’ – Wang Fuk Court survivors mourn 168 victims on first anniversary of tragic blaze
en.topic_summary:
Former Wang Fuk Court residents were among a stream of mourners filtering into a park facing the charred housing estate on Thursday, as they marked a year since a deadly blaze ripped through their homes and killed 168 people.



Mourners gather outside Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on November 26, 2026, one year after a blaze at the complex left 168 people dead. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Some of them had lost loved ones in the tragedy while others were displaced by the blaze that broke out on November
